Namespace Gadema.Core.Models.Base.Infrastructure

Classes

ActivityLog

Represents a business-level audit event within a project, used for accountability and history tracking.

AssetLink

Links content items to game engine asset systems, facilitating tracking of exported assets.

ContentSnapshot

Represents a content snapshot for the "Save Ritual", allowing users to create intentional milestones. These snapshots provide version control and are used to populate the timeline view in the UI.

ContentVersionLog

Represents a record of a specific version change for a content item, used to support rollback capabilities.

ExternalReference

Represents an external reference (e.g., Google Docs, Pinterest boards) linked to a content item. Used for referencing external resources such as GDD documents, art inspirations, or research material.

MediaAttachment

Represents a media file attached to a content item (e.g., images, PDFs, etc.). Supports tracking of uploaded files and their storage locations.
